speaker: Dialvo
text: Thanks for calling Northwind Agency. This call is transcribed so the team can follow up. How can I help?

speaker: Lead
text: Hi, it's Lena from Bright Smile Dental. We need a new website, with online booking.

speaker: Dialvo
text: Thanks. So I can point you to the right person: is this for one clinic, or more than one?

speaker: Lead
text: Two. We opened a second one in September, and bookings are all by phone.

speaker: Dialvo
text: Got it: two clinics, and booking by phone only. Are you hoping to have online booking live by a certain date?

speaker: Lead
text: Before January, ideally. How much does something like this cost?

speaker: Dialvo
text: It depends on your booking system, so I'd rather not guess. Priya leads our dental projects and can give you a proper figure in twenty minutes. Does Thursday at 2pm or Friday at 11am suit?

speaker: Dialvo
text: Thursday at 2pm with Priya, booked. I'll text you a confirmation, and the invite will come from Northwind. Is this the best number for the text?

speaker: Dialvo
text: It's on its way. Thanks, Lena. Priya will speak to you on Thursday.
